title: ‘Phantom forests’ in Australia’s arid outback used to create carbon credits meant to offset emissions, report claims
summary_full: Carbon credit companies reject research that found only small increase in forest and canopy cover in regeneration areas despite wet conditionsGet our daily political email, free app or daily news podcastA fight over the legitimacy of Australia’s climate change policy has reignited after researchers claimed “phantom forests” in the semi-arid outback are being used to create offsets that allow fossil fuel companies to keep pumping out pollution.A group of academics, including professors from the Australian National University and the University of New South Wales, said they had examined 50 forest regeneration projects used to create carbon credits.
